name: vex-mobile
description: Vex for Android — the Vex browser as a native Android shell (Capacitor + system WebView)

scripts.build:debug: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.check: node scripts/check-www.js && node scripts/check-api.mjs && node scripts/sync-themes.mjs --check && node scripts/sync-shared.mjs --check && node scripts/check-java.mjs
